summary: Join our Central Bank Investment Strategies Training to master investment techniques and improve your financial decision-making skills in a dynamic environment.
lede: Central bank investment strategy guides how reserve managers align portfolio decisions with their institution’s objectives and constraints. Designed for investment officers and related policy and risk teams, the course covers setting objectives and risk limits, building strategic asset allocations, and balancing liquidity with return. It also addresses measuring performance, stress-testing exposures, and communicating investment decisions clearly.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals deeply involved in the nuanced world of central bank investments, reserve management, and sovereign asset decision-making. Whether you are directly managing portfolios or advising on policies, this course provides the tools and insights needed to excel in your role.
audience: Central bank reserve managers and investment officers
Heads and staff of financial markets
Monetary policy and open market operations teams
Risk management and middle office professionals
Treasury and asset management teams in ministries
modules: Foundations of Central Bank Investment Strategy
Strategic Asset Allocation and Portfolio Construction
Risk Management in Central Bank Portfolios
Liquidity Management and Monetary Policy Operations
Stress Testing, Scenario Analysis, and Resilience
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of financial markets and central bank operations. Prior experience in investment or reserve management is beneficial but not required.
